description: Top 20 Nasdaq-listed (NMS) companies by live market cap (including SPCX #6) + MSTR

google_news_batches.label: SPCX_MSTR_Focus
google_news_batches.query: (SpaceX OR SPCX OR Starlink OR "MicroStrategy" OR "Strategy" MSTR OR "Michael Saylor") when:1d

google_news_batches.label: Semis_Core
google_news_batches.query: (NVDA OR NVIDIA OR AVGO OR Broadcom OR MU OR Micron OR AMD OR ASML OR INTC OR Intel OR TXN OR AMAT) (earnings OR guidance OR export OR ban OR acquisition OR deal OR launch OR SEC) when:1d

google_news_batches.label: MegaCap_Tech
google_news_batches.query: (AAPL OR Apple OR MSFT OR Microsoft OR GOOGL OR Alphabet OR AMZN OR Amazon OR META OR TSLA OR Tesla) (earnings OR guidance OR antitrust OR SEC OR acquisition OR DOJ OR EU OR recall OR tariff) when:1d

google_news_batches.label: Nasdaq_Top20_Rest
google_news_batches.query: (WMT OR Walmart OR COST OR Costco OR PLTR OR Palantir OR CSCO OR Cisco OR PANW OR "Palo Alto Networks") (earnings OR guidance OR contract OR acquisition OR SEC) when:1d

google_news_batches.label: X_Public_Signals
